description:
Create a task (note, to-do, appointment, or cancellation) in Propstack.

This is the central write endpoint for ALL activity types. The mode is
determined by which flags you set:

MODE 1 — Note (Notiz):
  Just provide title + body. No special flags needed.
  Example: log a call note after a conversation.

MODE 2 — To-do (Aufgabe):
  Set is_reminder: true + due_date.
  Example: "remind me to call Herr Müller back tomorrow"

MODE 3 — Appointment (Termin):
  Set is_event: true + starts_at + ends_at.
  Example: "schedule a viewing at Musterstr 12 at 3pm"

MODE 4 — Cancellation (Absage):
  Set reservation_reason_id to a valid reason.
  Example: "cancel deal — buyer withdrew financing"

Always link tasks to contacts/properties/projects via the *_ids arrays
so they appear in the correct activity feeds.

The body field accepts HTML content.

body.description: Task body (HTML allowed). Call notes, meeting minutes, etc.

client_ids.description: Contact IDs to link this task to

due_date.description: Due date for to-do (ISO 8601). Requires is_reminder: true

ends_at.description: Event end time (ISO 8601). Requires is_event: true

is_event.description: Set true to create an Appointment/Termin (MODE 3)

is_reminder.description: Set true to create a To-do/Aufgabe (MODE 2)

note_type_id.description: Activity type ID (e.g. for note, brief, SMS subtypes)

private.description: Private event — hidden from other brokers

project_ids.description: Project IDs to link this task to

property_ids.description: Property IDs to link this task to

remind_at.description: Reminder notification time (ISO 8601). Requires is_reminder: true

reservation_reason_id.description: Cancellation reason ID — setting this activates MODE 4 (Absage)

starts_at.description: Event start time (ISO 8601). Requires is_event: true

name: create_task
